title: Pre Xtreme
summary: This event was organized by Hackers club of University of Peradeniya and IEEE Student branch of University of Perdeniya as a practice session to IEEEXtreme 13.0. Cash ptices were given to the best performing teams. The competition was mentored and evaluated by Dr. Asitha Bandaranayake and Dr. Isuru Nawinne.
